wiki.title: Rachele Lamosao
wiki.extract: Rachele Lamosao is an American politician serving in the Hawaii Senate for the 19th district. She previously served in the Hawaii House of Representatives, representing the 36th district (Waipahu). She won the seat in the 2022 election against Republican opponent Veamoniti Lautaha. In December 2025 she was appointed to the Senate.
